#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to check if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

# Function to check if a port is open and responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name
    local timeout=5

    case $port in
        3000) service_name="Service A" ;;
        8080) service_name="Service B" ;;
        *)    service_name="Service on port $port" ;;
    esac

    # Try to connect to the port using curl (HTTP check)
    if curl -s --head --connect-timeout $timeout "http://localhost:$port" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[✓] $service_name (port $port) is responding"
        return 0
    else
        # Fallback to checking if port is open using netcat or /dev/tcp
        if (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port) 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "[⚠] $service_name (port $port) is accepting connections but HTTP check failed"
            return 0
        else
            echo "[✗] $service_name (port $port) is NOT responding"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

echo "======================================"
echo "Service Health Check"
echo "Date: $(date)"
echo "======================================"
echo ""

# Track overall health
overall_health=0

# Check port 3000
check_port 3000 || overall_health=1

# Check port 8080
check_port 8080 || overall_health=1

echo ""
echo "======================================"
if [ $overall_health -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Overall Status: ✓ All services are HEALTHY"
else
    echo "Overall Status: ✗ Some services are UNHEALTHY"
fi
echo "======================================"
